description: P3 consumer-assertion: the overlord's navigator-transport grants (the .hivemind/* input-file handoffs used by seed-hive, spawn-brood, init-run-ledger, record-state-result, mark-intent-fallback, molt, open-plan-pr and the review loop) are PROMPT PRE-APPROVAL rules — Edit(<pattern>) entries in .claude/settings.json and in hivemind_settings_permissions_template() in plugin/skills/_shared/settings-merge.sh. They deliver NO path scoping: an allow rule pre-approves, it never denies, and an absent rule yields an interactive prompt rather than a refusal. The transport-path constraint ITSELF is enforced by the fixed-literal prefix + invocation-token file_path authored in the trusted skill body. This fixture pins the rules because respelling Edit( as Write( silently UNMATCHES them: from Claude Code 2.1.210 onward a Write(<pattern>) rule is accepted by settings parsing but NEVER matched by file permission checks, so the pre-approval stops suppressing the prompt while looking correct. extract_regex captures BOTH spellings so a Write( regression surfaces as an EXTRA (plus a MISSING for the lost Edit( literal) instead of vanishing from the set; equal mode also fails if a rule is deleted from either file or if the two files drift apart.
